_comment: One Vercel project, two services, one origin. The web app is served at / and the API at /api, which is the same shape as local dev — where Vite proxies /api to :4000 — so the browser never makes a cross-origin request in either environment. That is why no CORS_ORIGINS entry and no VITE_API_BASE_URL are needed here: the two settings most likely to be got wrong simply do not exist in this setup.

headers._comment: Hashed filenames, so they can be cached forever. Anything that changes gets a new name.

api._comment: Runs the real server — the same dist/server.js that `npm start` runs — rather than a separate serverless wrapper. One definition of every route, shared by local dev and production. `npm run build` emits dist/ before this entrypoint is used, and server.ts already listens on process.env.PORT, which Vercel assigns.

rewrites._comment: A service receives the ORIGINAL path, so the API sees /api/impact and the routers mounted at /api in app.ts match unchanged. Nothing is stripped.
The platform health probe lives at the root of the API, outside /api, because it is what an uptime check hits.
Everything else is the web app. Order matters: this is a catch-all and must come last.
